verdict.rationale: Simular's platform docs say the same Sai agent runs on a Simular-hosted Windows or Linux cloud computer, or on the user's own Mac or Windows PC. The BYOD docs confirm macOS and Windows device support, and the open-source framework is described as working across environments. missing for 10: detailed per-target documentation (setup, capability differences, or limitations per OS), mobile targets, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-OS behavior.
